div.head: VIII Atr 36
div.ab: And wise wæran worldwitan, þe to godcundan rihtlagan woroldlaga settan, folce to steore, ⁊ Criste ⁊ cyninge gerihtan þa bote, þar man swa scolde manega for neode gewildan to rihte.
And wise wæran worldwitan þe to godcundan rihtlagan woroldlaga settan, folce to steore, ⁊ Criste ⁊ cyninge gerehtan þa bote þar man swa scolde manega for neode gewildan to rihte.
And wise wæran worldwitan þe to godcundan rihtlagan woroldlaga settan folce to steore, and Criste and cyninge gerehtan þa bote, þar man swa scolde manega for neode gewildan to rihte.

Und weise waren die Staatsregenten, welche zu geistlichen Rechtsgesetzen staatliche Gesetze aufstellten, dem Volke zur Zucht, und Christo und dem König den Bussertrag zusprachen, wofern viele so durch Zwang zum Recht gezwungen werden mussten.

And wise were the secular councillors who added secular laws to the laws of God, for the discipline of the people, and assigned the compensation to Christ and the king, so that many might thus be forced to right by compulsion.

And secular councillors showed wisdom in appointing civil laws to uphold the privileges of religion, for the governance of the people, and in assigning the compensation to Christ and the king, so that thereby many are forced of necessity to submit to justice.

And wise were the secular councillors who appointed secular laws to uphold religious rights, for the control of the people, and assigned the compensations to Christ and the king, whereby many should thus be forced by necessity to do right.

And wise were the secular councilors who established worldly laws in support of divine justice, for the guidance of the people, and to allocate compensation to Christ and the king so that out of necessity many must therefore submit to the law.
